answer: An agent economy can verify distinct network positions: each epoch, beacons on opposite shores of the ocean send a cipher challenge that must be answered within milliseconds, and the reply travels back over copper and fiber whose latency betrays true distance. One honest agent answers its nearest beacon cheaply. A sybil farmer running a thousand fakes on one rack cannot fake a thousand locations: identical round-trip times cluster the puppets into one point, and the network slashes the whole cluster. Cloning keys cannot clone geography.
